hero.headline: Documents, tasks, and conversations connect as one, so your team decides and moves faster.
hero.sub: Wiki, kanban, channel, and data come together in one project.
hero.note: You pay each month only for the seats you use.

problem.headline: The same team, split across tools.
problem.body: Documents stay in docs, work stays on a board, decisions stay in chat, and data stays in a sheet. The team explains the same work again.

docs.title: Documents
docs.body: The source of truth sits outside the work.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: Execution is visible only on a board.

structure.headline: Team space and work space are separate.
structure.body: Manage people in a workspace. Do the work in a project.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.body: A team space for notices, boards, and members.

project.title: Project
project.body: A work space for wiki, kanban, channel, and data.

features.headline: Documents become work, and work meets conversation.
features.sub: Write in wiki, move on the board, decide in the channel.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.body: Write pages and manage files and permissions.

kanban.title: Kanban
kanban.body: See the board, schedule, and backlog as one set of work.

channel.title: Channel
channel.body: Share notices, everyday talk, and work conversations.

pricing.headline: Pay each month only for the seats you open.
pricing.body: There is no fixed plan. Nothing is billed inside the starting allowance: 1 workspace, 3 projects, and 5 members.
pricing.storage: Each workspace includes 5 GB. Extra storage is $0.10 per GB each month.

member.title: Member
member.body: Invites one person to that workspace.

closing.headline: One connected flow. Keep going.
closing.body: You start after your request is approved.
